# xshield_named_networks (Data Source)

Named networks matching a criteria, with their address ranges.

Ranges are reported in the canonical form the backend stores, which may differ from the text originally entered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "xshield_named_networks" "all" {}

output "ranges" {
  value = {
    for n in data.xshield_named_networks.all.named_networks :
    n.named_network_name => [for r in n.ip_ranges : r.ip_range]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the named networks. Defaults to every named network.
- `max_results` (Number) Stop after this many results. Left unset, every match is read. When a limit truncates the result set, `truncated` is true.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the matching named networks, in the same order as the detailed list. Convenient for `for_each`.
- `named_networks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--named_networks))
- `total` (Number) Total number of named networks matching the criteria, as reported by the API.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_results` stopped the read before the end of the result set.

<a id="nestedatt--named_networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `named_networks`

Read-Only:

- `asset_assignments` (Number)
- `assigned_by_tag_based_policy` (Boolean)
- `colortokens_managed` (Boolean) True for a network shipped with the platform.
- `id` (String)
- `ip_ranges` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--named_networks--ip_ranges))
- `named_network_description` (String)
- `named_network_name` (String)
- `program_as_internet` (Boolean) Whether traffic to this network counts as internet.
- `program_as_intranet` (Boolean) Whether traffic to this network counts as intranet.
- `region` (String)
- `segment_assignments` (Number)
- `service` (String)
- `total_count` (Number) Total addresses across every range.

<a id="nestedatt--named_networks--ip_ranges"></a>
### Nested Schema for `named_networks.ip_ranges`

Read-Only:

- `ip_count` (Number) Addresses the range covers.
- `ip_range` (String) Range in canonical CIDR form.
